name: Strike-through opens into the app icon
looks: A bold two-line headline names the chore ("Stop retyping.") with a hand-drawn line struck through the verb; the frame cuts to the app's rounded-square icon centred alone, the wordmark and a one-line tagline settling beneath it.
build: Struck word's line draws on with a slight hand-wobble (~250ms) before the headline cuts away. Icon arrives with a small scale-in (`0.9 -> 1`, power2.out), wordmark and tagline fading in beneath it in turn, 120ms apart.
sound: A marker-pen scribble on the strike, a soft pop on the icon's arrival.
prompt: Open on a bold headline naming a tedious chore, strike a hand-drawn line through the key word, then cut to the app's icon alone on a soft ground with its wordmark and a one-line tagline settling in beneath it.
